lessons.pregame_expectation: 2 published claims said the same thing: EdgeDesk prices this game at Oklahoma −8.0 with a fair total of 49.0, which makes Oklahoma the better team here by that margin on this field. EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma −8.0 where the market has Oklahoma −6.5 at captured consensus (stale) · 1 book · best at BetRivers — a 1.3 points disagreement.
lessons.actual_result: Oklahoma Sooners lost by 8 where EdgeDesk projected a 7.8-point edge. Oklahoma Sooners lost by 8.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk named Oklahoma as better in market and the game went the other way, across 2 separate published claims. One game does not overturn a season-long rating, but this is the direction to watch: Kentucky Wildcats won the game outright
lessons.suggested_investigation: These claims carried 9.1 points of the published number between them and were contradicted. Check whether the same category has been contradicted in other games this season before touching anything.

lessons.pregame_expectation: 8 of the claims in this article rested on model, passing, rushing, special_teams.
lessons.actual_result: None of them could be graded: no single-game statistic in EdgeDesk’s vocabulary observes this driver; the read does not name a side, so there is no direction to test.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk prices these games partly on signals it has no way to observe afterwards. That is not an error in the model — it is a gap in the audit, and it means the platform cannot tell, from results alone, whether those parts of the number are earning their weight.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Consider whether a postgame data source exists for model, passing, rushing.

lessons.pregame_expectation: EdgeDesk published a fair total of 48.9.
lessons.actual_result: The game finished with 34 points, an error of 14.9.
lessons.lesson: A total missed by this much usually means a pace or a finishing assumption was wrong, not that both ratings were. Check which of the two moved.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Was the play count or the points per drive the miss? Both are in this game’s result record.

lessons.pregame_expectation: EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma −8.0 where the market has Oklahoma −6.5 at captured consensus (stale) · 1 book · best at BetRivers — a 1.3 points disagreement.
lessons.actual_result: Oklahoma Sooners lost by 8. the result landed on the market’s side of the disagreement
lessons.lesson: The market had the better estimate here. EdgeDesk’s disagreement was not information on this game, and the honest reading is that the price already contained what the model thought it had found.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Track disagreements of this size across the season. The question is not whether one landed; it is whether the class of them has any edge at all.
